locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: Hic autem non est procedere in infinitum
interpretation: The regress premise as its own statement, restricted to per se links. Formalized as well-foundedness (Lean Acc) of MovesAsMoved, i.e. no infinite ascending chain of moved movers each moving only as moved. Aquinas' supporting reason (no first mover, hence no other mover) is recorded in the second-movers claim, which supplies the per se ordering; the well-foundedness reading treats 'non est procedere in infinitum' as a substantive premise rather than deriving it.
